# Psalm 32 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. A-Maskil. Blessed-is [the one whose] transgression [is] forgiven, [whose] sin [is] covered.

**2** Blessed-is the-man to-whom YHWH does-not impute iniquity, and-in-whose spirit there-is-no deceit.

**3** When I-kept-silent, my-bones wasted-away through-my-groaning all the-day.

**4** For day and-night Your-hand was-heavy upon-me; my-moisture was-changed [as in] the-drought of-summer. Selah.

**5** My-sin I-made-known to-You, and-my-iniquity I-did-not cover. I-said, 'I-will-confess my-transgressions to-YHWH,' and-You forgave the-guilt of-my-sin. Selah.

**6** Therefore let-every-faithful-one pray to-You at-a-time of-finding; surely in-the-flood of-many waters they-shall-not reach-him.

**7** You [are] a-hiding-place for-me; from-distress You-preserve-me; with-shouts-of deliverance You-surround-me. Selah.

**8** I-will-instruct-you and-teach-you in-the-way you-should-go; I-will-counsel-you with-My-eye upon-you.

**9** Do-not be like-a-horse, like-a-mule, without understanding, whose-trappings [are] bit and-bridle to-restrain [it] — [or else it] will-not come-near to-you.

**10** Many [are] the-sorrows of-the-wicked, but-the-one-trusting in-YHWH — steadfast-love surrounds-him.

**11** Be-glad in-YHWH and-rejoice, O-righteous; and-shout-for-joy, all [you] upright of-heart.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **32:1-2**: Paul quotes these verses in Romans 4:7-8 as his primary proof-text for justification by faith — blessedness not through works but through forgiveness.

— EMET
